profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a credit bureau based in Atlanta, Georgia, according to its website. The company says it provides credit reports and credit scores for both businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools that include daily monitoring and alerts. Its site also describes Equifax Complete, a product it says monitors a customer's Equifax credit report, provides alerts, and offers recovery help after identity theft, including work by what the company calls dedicated ID Restoration Specialists. Much of the site's content is educational, covering credit reports, fraud warning signs, debt, credit cards, loans, and personal finance, with some material offered in Spanish.

The site's material centers on consumer credit and identity protection rather than on AI products. No AI products are listed among the company's tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.

Equifax is a public company traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker EFX, with SEC CIK 0000033185. Its headquarters are listed as Atlanta, Georgia, and it is recorded as a for-profit public company. No lawsuits are recorded against it.
